tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// 'phags pa sa'i snying po'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa gzungs sngags dang bcas pa bzhugs so//

༄༅// 'phags pa sa'i snying po'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa gzungs sngags dang bcas pa/ dkyil 'khor gyi rgyal po chen po byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sa'i snying po la phyag 'tshal lo// oṃ sum bha ni sum bha/ ha ra tsa ra/ ma hā pā sha ma ru tā/ a mo gha badz+ra sa twa swā hā/ de nas yon tan byin pa yi// gzungs 'di bshad ma thag tu yang*// rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor dam pa ni// ti se'i gangs bcas g.yos par gyur// sa yi snying po tshogs dbang la// bcom ldan rdo rje can gyis smras// skal ldan chen po legs so legs// sa steng khyod kyis yangs par byas// khyod kyi gzungs ni rnam grags shing*// yon tan dpag med mchog skyed pa// sems can kun gyi sdug bsngal dang*// nyes pa zlog byed thos pa ni/ 'khor bar rab tu rgyu ba na// nyes pa kun gyis mi gos te// ji ltar 'dam gyi pad+ma dag /'dam gyi nyes pas mi gos bzhin// lus can dag las su yang rung*// khyad kyis gsang sngags 'chad byed pa// de dag las ni gcig tsam yang*/ byang chub las ni log mi 'gyur// mkhas pa gang zhig gzungs sngags mchog /thos nas mos par byed pa ni// nges par yon tan thams cad kyang*// thob par 'gyur te the tshom med// de nas thams cad ldan pa'i 'khor// langs te sa yi dbang phyug po// sa yi snying po sa mchog la// ming brgya rtsa brgyad smras pa ni// sa yi snying po gtso bo che// glog 'gyu lta bu'i spyan mnga' ba// cod pan can te sa brnyes pa// phun sum tshogs ldan 'byor ba mchog /rig ldan rig mdzad mchod pa'i gnas// gtso bo dge sbyong ston pa po// gzhi bcas ldan pa'i rlung gi tshul// swā hā'i blo ldan snying rje'i rab// thams cad mkhyen pa nyi ma'i mchog /snying po snying po mkhyen par grags// gsang sngags rol cing rgya cher rol// sa yi dbang phyug gar stabs can// sgeg po zhal bzang gar mkhan ldan// 'bras bu mngon sum ston pa po// rab 'byor blo gros snying po mkhyen// snying po brnyes pa 'jigs pa med// mgon po sangs rgyas gzugs mnga' ba// shes rab kyis ni ma lus gzigs// 'dod chags la sogs skyon sel cing*// gar stabs chen po ston pa po// ston pa dpag bsam shing dang 'dra// nam mkha'i dbang phyug gsung snyan pa// nyi ma chen po nyid yin te// dbang phyug chen po 'bar bas bskor// yon tan mtha' yas longs spyod pa// sa yi dbang phyug spyod yul can// chos kyi longs spyod longs spyod che// yon tan rgya mtsho'i gangs chen mtsho// yon tan sna tshogs longs spyod pa// de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi mchog

/thabs tshul zab la mkhas pa ste// theg pa chen po 'jigs pa med// mchod pa chen po sgra che ba// zla ltar grags pa'i dkyil 'khor can// rdo rje 'chang chen mtshan brgya pa/ rdo rje dkyil 'khor me tog thod/ blo gros chen po phyag ring ba// pad+ma chen po stobs po che// gsang sngags chen po tshogs chen po// sa gzhi chen po lhun po lags// lag na rdo rje yon tan des// nor bu'i me tog thod kyis brgyan// mnyam nyid 'byams la longs spyod pa// rgya chen zhing gi rgya mtsho can// rdo rje'i 'od mnga' rdo rje ldan// sa yi bdag po lhun po bzhin// sa la longs spyod longs spyod bzang*// mtshon cha g.yo ba phun sum tshogs// rab 'byams snod ni rnam par grangs// smra mkhas rdo rje rab 'joms pa// spyan rtsa yid tsam dmar ba ste// me tog sngon po'i thod kyis bcings// spro ba chen po phyag ring ba// brtan po brtan la bde sbyin pa// ded dpon dpal bzang chen po ste// gangs can lhun po lta bu lags// dbang po gshin rje rgyal chen dang*/ btsan po khyab 'jug stobs dbang phyug /'jig rten mchog rigs sangs rgyas tshangs// de bzhin nyid tshul spyod yul can// rin chen tog ste cher bzhad pa// dgyes pa na bza' sna tshogs gsol// gzigs pa ring ba spyan yangs pa/ nam mkha' bzhin du thogs pa med// thogs pa mi dpogs rin chen gtsug /srid gsum 'dod pa med pa'i rgyu// dul ba nyon mongs dri ma bstsal// dag pa gtsang ba gso sbyong can// rnam par gnon pa'i g.yul las 'das// ljang mdog skyabs mdzad snying rje che// stobs kyi grags pa rgya che ba// bsams na shes pa'i spyod yul can// dpa' bos seng ge 'jigs par byed// sdang ba rnams kyi snying 'joms pa/ mnga' bdag grags pa yul dang ldan// dga' ba rgya cher rab 'byung ba// rigs mkhyen rigs kyi snying po mkhyen// rigs kun tu ni mchod pa lags// rgyal po rigs mchog skyes pa'i rten// rdo rje yi ni dkyil 'khor rgyan// rdo rje sa 'og rab grags pa// rig sngags 'chang ba stobs po che// mngon par 'phags pa khyab pa mchog

/mgrin bzang nad dang bral ba lags// skyong mdzad ston pa dag pa ste// sangs rgyas lam ni rab ston pa// grol ba smon mdzad 'dud par mdzad// dkyil 'khor ma lus rnams kyis brgyan// rab zhugs dkyil 'khor rnams la mkhas// rdo rje'i slob dpon yon tan rten// grub pa sbyin pa rnam dag mchog /tshul dang tshul min rtogs pa po// dkyil 'khor rtsa ser mnga' ba ste// 'od zer ljang gu'i 'od dang ldan// ser la na bza' ser po bsnams// dkyil 'khor ma lus kun gyi rgyan// spyan rtsa dmar ba zla ba'i dpal/ nor bu sna tshogs 'od 'byung ba// rdo rje rgya yi stobs kyis spro// mnyam nyid mnyam pa dri ma med// sku yang dag cing na bza' dag /dag pa mkhyen cing dag par ldan// dag pa'i chos mnga' snang ba ste// 'byung ldan srid pa sel mdzad pa// 'khor ba zad mdzad shes rab can// tshul shes tshul la spyod yul ba// rdo rje rgya mtsho'i snying po lags// rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che// 'byung ldan rab 'byams shes rab can// ma lus grags pa'i 'od bzang ba// sa yi snying po snying po che// rdo rje'i snying po rnam par 'dren// dpag tu med pa dpag med rdzogs// khyad par 'phags pa'i yul la gnas// zab cing gsal ba'i gtso bo ste// zla ba'i dkyil 'khor 'od zer bsil// dga' dang dwang ba skyed pa ste// ye shes rgya chen spyod yul ba// rlung gi drag shul lta bur drag /drag po lags te drag sel gtsang*// rgyal bar byed cing rgyal ba zhi// rgyal ba'i dpal mdzad dga' bar mdzad// lhun po ti se ma la yas// spyod yul zab mo non pa ste// rin chen rdo rje snying po che// sa gzhi'i spyod yul mnga' ba lags// rin chen brag las byung ba'i 'od// rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor dag gis brgyan// de bzhin ga shags la lhur dgyes pa// shugs drag dpal gyi gzhi rten lags// rab gsal dpal mdzad gtsang ma ste/

phyogs bcu'i dbang phyug dbang phyug che// de ltar rdo rje 'chang chen la// ming brgya rtsa brgyad mchog rnams kyis// rdo rje sems dpas bstod nas ni// rdo rje sa gsum dbang mchog smras// yon tan snying po shes rnams kyis// ming brgya rtsa brgyad mchog brjod cing*// nyes pa zlog pa 'di las gzhan/ sa yi steng na ngas ma mthong*// ming brgya rtsa brgyad dam pa 'di// thams cad 'grub byed dga' ba ste// sdig pa thams cad sel ba dang*// dri ma kun bral yon tan nges// de phyir sgrib pa thams cad kyis// phun sum tshogs pa 'dod pa'i mis// ming brgya rtsa brgyad dge ba 'di// rtag tu yang ni brjod par gyis// ming brgya rtsa brgyad dam pa 'di// bsam pa kun dang 'byor ba yi// gnas mchog bla na med pa ste// dpal yon rgya chen sbyin pa yin// yid ni shin tu dang ba yis// sa yi snying po'i mtshan gsal ba// 'dod pa thams cad rab sgrub pa'i// yon tan mchog ni gang brjod dang*// dpal yon rgya chen 'dzin pa yi// ming brgya rtsa brgyad dam pa 'di/ mi ni gang zhig rjod byed pa// sdug bsngal kun las myur du grol// 'phags pa sa'i snying po'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa gzungs sngags dang bcas pa rdzogs so/// /
